capabilities.description: Reads the file through the host file service and parses it as RFC 4180 CSV: quoted fields, escaped quotes, line breaks inside quotes, CRLF or LF, an optional UTF-8 BOM. With a header (the default) each row is an object keyed by column; every value is a string.
capabilities.name: parse-csv
capabilities.summary: Parse a CSV file into rows.
useCases: Turn a spreadsheet of variants into rows a forEach can run over

capabilities.description: Resolves step input, evaluates the step script in QuickJS, and returns JSON matching the step returns schema. The handler is not called.
capabilities.name: transform
projections: Take the object your step returns schema describes
capabilities.summary: Run a JavaScript transform in the host sandbox.
useCases: Reshape data between capability steps without a domain plugin

plugin.description: Supplies step-contract capabilities so executions can declare accepts, returns and scripts on the step node.
plugin.summary: Core transform, step-contract and CSV capabilities bundled with the host.
